as_written_in_papers.quote: Whole-exome sequencing revealed a novel compound heterozygous mutation in LPIN2: c.2349del (p.Glu784ArgfsTer8), inherited from the mother, and c.2327+3A>G, inherited from the father (Figure 3).

cases.statement: One affected person (a girl, compound heterozygous with c.2327+3A>G) and her mother (carrier, no symptoms reported) in a single family, PMID 41113563. The variant is not in the paper's own review table of 35 earlier patients.

people.label: patient (proband)
people.key_phenotypes: recurrent knee and ankle swelling and pain from 1 y 8 mo; low-grade fever with elevated CRP/ESR during attacks; mild microcytic anemia; bone marrow edema of distal femurs, proximal left tibia and ankles on MRI; no rash

quotes.quote: A 3-year and 10-month-old girl was admitted to our hospital on November 9, 2021, with a history of intermittent joint pain for more than two years, first manifesting at 1 year and 8 months of age.
Each attack was associated with low-grade fever and elevated inflammatory markers, including C-reactive protein (CRP) and erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR).
During the attack phase, laboratory findings showed mild anemia (hemoglobin 103 g/L; reference 112–149 g/L), with microcytic indices (MCV 81.5 fL, MCH 26.2 pg).
Imaging of the lower limbs revealed bone marrow edema and soft tissue swelling involving both distal femurs (Figure 1), the proximal left tibia, and both ankles.
Ibuprofen provided only partial relief, and there was no history of rash, oral ulcers, cough, vomiting, or diarrhea.

people.label: mother of patient
people.zygosity_or_genotype: carrier (variant inherited from her); zygosity not stated in words, heterozygous implied
people.key_phenotypes: no symptoms reported (no family history of similar symptoms); about half the normal LPIN2 transcript level on qRT-PCR

quotes.quote: Whole-exome sequencing revealed a novel compound heterozygous mutation in LPIN2: c.2349del (p.Glu784ArgfsTer8), inherited from the mother, and c.2327+3A>G, inherited from the father (Figure 3).
In contrast, both the proband and the mother exhibited approximately half the normal level of LPIN2 transcript (Figure 5).
The child was the first pregnancy and first delivery (G1P1), and no family history of similar symptoms was reported.

phenotype_specificity.statement: Proband: CRMO-like multifocal bone marrow edema plus mild microcytic anemia; autoimmune markers and an infectious workup were negative. Bone marrow showed 21% erythroid precursors with mild anisocytosis; no dyserythropoietic morphology is described, although the authors call the anemia congenital dyserythropoietic anemia. The paper does not state whether whole-exome sequencing excluded variants in other genes.

quotes.quote: Immunological markers, including ANA, HLA-B27, rheumatoid factor, and anti-CCP, were negative, and 25-hydroxyvitamin D was normal.
Extensive infectious workup was negative, including anti-streptolysin O, Epstein–Barr virus, respiratory pathogens, parvovirus B19, and Mycoplasma pneumoniae.
Bone marrow cytology showed 21% erythroid precursors (Figure 2), predominantly at the intermediate and late stages, with mild anisocytosis among mature erythrocytes.
Taken together with the clinical features of recurrent multifocal osteomyelitis and congenital dyserythropoietic anemia, these findings established the diagnosis of Majeed syndrome.

segregation.statement: No other affected relatives. The unaffected mother carries the variant; the unaffected father carries the other allele. The proband is the only child.

quotes.quote: The child was the first pregnancy and first delivery (G1P1), and no family history of similar symptoms was reported.

de_novo.statement: Not de novo: inherited from the mother. Both parents were sequenced. Parentage confirmation is not reported.

functional.statement: Patient-derived blood RNA (PAXgene) used for quantitative RT-PCR: the mother (c.2349del carrier) and the proband had about half the normal LPIN2 transcript level, and the father (splice-variant carrier) had a normal level. The paper gives no reference group or control numbers. It does not say in words that c.2349del causes the reduction, and it does not mention nonsense-mediated decay.

quotes.quote: In addition, RNA samples were collected in PAXgene tubes, reverse-transcribed into cDNA, and analyzed by gel electrophoresis and sequencing.
quantitative RT-PCR analysis revealed that the LPIN2 mRNA level in the proband's father was within the normal range
In contrast, both the proband and the mother exhibited approximately half the normal level of LPIN2 transcript (Figure 5).

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: Single-nucleotide deletion causing a frameshift, p.(Glu784ArgfsTer8) (from the batch HGVS). The authors call it a frameshift. They describe the disease mechanism as loss of lipin-2's regulation of the NLRP3 inflammasome and IL-1β.

quotes.quote: c.2349del (p.Glu784ArgfsTer8), a frameshift mutation inherited from the mother
Mutations in LPIN2 impair this regulatory function, leading to excessive IL-1β signaling and the systemic inflammation that characterizes Majeed syndrome (4).

population_data_in_papers.statement: Not in HGMD, dbSNP or 1000 Genomes per the authors (gnomAD not mentioned).

quotes.quote: Neither variant was reported in HGMD, dbSNP, or the 1000 Genomes Project.

authors_classification.statement: Authors classify it as likely pathogenic under ACMG guidelines; criteria codes not given.

quotes.quote: The first variant was classified as likely pathogenic, while the second was predicted by VarSEAK to alter mRNA splicing.

concerns: Single family, single paper; transcript not stated in the paper.
Mother's zygosity is implied by 'inherited from the mother' but not stated in words; her phenotype is covered only by 'no family history of similar symptoms'.
The half-normal transcript level in mother and proband suggests reduced mRNA from the c.2349del allele, but the authors do not draw that link in words or name nonsense-mediated decay.
Bone marrow description (21% erythroid precursors, mild anisocytosis) shows no explicit dyserythropoiesis, yet the authors describe congenital dyserythropoietic anemia.
Same person also carries candidate G-majeed-003 (c.2327+3A>G).
notes_for_panel: Compound heterozygous with c.2327+3A>G (G-majeed-003), phase set by trio sequencing. The qRT-PCR result is the only variant-related functional data. It uses patient blood RNA, and the paper gives no control numbers.
